props.name: autocomplete
props.description: The autocomplete attribute for the input.

props.name: autofocus
props.description: Whether the input should automatically receive focus on mount.

props.name: autofocusDelay
props.description: The delay in milliseconds before automatically focusing the input.

props.name: children
props.description: Native controls do not accept child content.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The default value of the input (uncontrolled).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the input is disabled.

props.name: id
props.description: The ID of the input element.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: The maximum number of characters allowed in the input.

props.name: modelModifiers
props.description: Modifiers for the input value (e.g., trim, lazy, number).

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the input element, used for form submission.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Event handler for the blur event.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Native change event, after value synchronization and Field notification.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Event handler for the focus event.

props.name: onInput
props.description: Event handler for the input event.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Callback when the input value changes during input.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The placeholder text for the input.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the input is read-only.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref for the native input element.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the input is required.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: type
props.description: The type of the input element.

props.name: value
props.description: The current value of the input (controlled).
